scope: Invented government-reading examples for eight opt-in pilot entries. This is a behavior regression set, not a natural-text coverage benchmark or user study.

behaviorCases.text: We will reply at a later date.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: We will reply later.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: At the present time, the office is open.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: Now, the office is open.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: Use this form for the purpose of requesting a copy.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: Use this form for requesting a copy.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: In the event that the office closes, keep the receipt.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: If the office closes, keep the receipt.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: Keep a copy so as to track the request.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: Keep a copy to track the request.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: Write to us with regard to the appointment.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: Write to us about the appointment.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: Work may commence next week.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: Work may start next week.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: The session commences at noon.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: The session starts at noon.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: The session commenced at noon.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: The session started at noon.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: Work is commencing next week.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: Work is starting next week.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: You may utilize this form.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: You may use this form.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: The office utilizes this form.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: The office uses this form.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: The office utilized this form.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: The office used this form.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: The office is utilizing this form.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: The office is using this form.
behaviorCases.note: A complete sentence checks meaning, word type, tense and grammatical fit for this explicit pair.

behaviorCases.text: In the event of rain, stay inside.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: In the event of rain, stay inside.
behaviorCases.note: The phrase followed by a noun cannot be replaced with if.

behaviorCases.text: The display is so bright as to hurt my eyes.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: The display is so bright as to hurt my eyes.
behaviorCases.note: A separated so ... as to pattern is not the purpose phrase.

behaviorCases.text: The applicant shall receive a reply.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: The applicant shall receive a reply.
behaviorCases.note: Shall can express an obligation or prediction; no mechanical substitute.

behaviorCases.text: Put these pages in order to help the next reader.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: Put these pages in order to help the next reader.
behaviorCases.note: In order may describe ordering the pages; no automatic deletion.

behaviorCases.text: The commencement date is on the form.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: The commencement date is on the form.
behaviorCases.note: Noun form is not generated from the verb pair.

behaviorCases.text: The report measures utilization.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: The report measures utilization.
behaviorCases.note: Noun form is not generated from the verb pair.

behaviorCases.text: They hold this office in high regard.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: They hold this office in high regard.
behaviorCases.note: Ordinary regard is not the complete topic phrase.

behaviorCases.text: Use it for the sole purpose of requesting a copy.
behaviorCases.expectedOutput: Use it for the sole purpose of requesting a copy.
behaviorCases.note: Only an explicitly listed complete phrase may replace text.
